claims.subject: site identity
claims.proposition: A real garage/redevelopment parcel at/rear of 73A and 73B Woodside Green is identified by Croydon planning records and appeal history.
claims.limitation: Identified screening subject does not itself prove title/control extent.

claims.subject: borough and planning authority
claims.proposition: The site lies in the London Borough of Croydon.
claims.limitation: Borough identity selects authority context only; it does not prove policy compliance.

claims.subject: historical garage/redevelopment condition
claims.proposition: Relevant historical proposals described demolition of existing garages.
claims.limitation: Current October 2026 physical state is not established; the site is not modelled as definitely garage-occupied, cleared or built out.

claims.subject: historical one-house permission
claims.proposition: Croydon granted 24/03598/FUL for demolition of garages and one two-storey four-bedroom dwelling with off-street parking.
claims.limitation: Does not establish implementation, current permission status, Reference House acceptability, technical compliance or present site condition.

claims.subject: later two-house refusal and appeal
claims.proposition: A later two-dwelling proposal was refused and appeal 6005406 was dismissed on 2026-05-12.

claims.subject: character and massing sensitivity
claims.proposition: The 2026 appeal treated character/appearance and scale/massing relationship as material and harmful for the two-house scheme.
claims.limitation: Does not imply the Reference House fails D3 or any local design policy.

claims.subject: private amenity-space sensitivity
claims.proposition: The appeal found one proposed private garden insufficiently functional/usable in the two-house scheme.
claims.limitation: Qualitative amenity judgement is not converted into a numeric site rule or a Reference House verdict.

claims.subject: parking and highway issue
claims.proposition: Parking provision formed an appeal issue, but highway-safety harm was not the decisive basis of the appeal outcome in the recovered summary.
claims.limitation: Does not create a site-wide parking entitlement or prove current access/highway adequacy.

claims.subject: site area
claims.proposition: Exact parcel area is not established by the admitted screening evidence.
claims.limitation: No area is reverse-engineered from screenshots, map tiles or marketing material.

claims.subject: boundary geometry, frontage and depth
claims.proposition: Exact legal/survey boundary geometry, frontage and depth are not established.
claims.limitation: Constrained urban-parcel history is not a substitute for title/survey geometry.

claims.subject: access geometry and status
claims.proposition: Vehicle/site-access relationships existed in historical proposals, but exact current access geometry, construction access, legal rights and route levels are not established.
claims.limitation: Historical proposal access is not current survey/title/highway evidence.

claims.subject: topography and levels
claims.proposition: Current site topography and levels are unknown at admitted evidence.
claims.limitation: Proposal-specific raised-garden discussion is not treated as a topographical survey.

claims.subject: trees and landscape
claims.proposition: Current tree/TPO/arboricultural condition is not established by the admitted screening evidence.
claims.limitation: No tree/TPO conclusion is inferred from absence of evidence.

claims.subject: ground, drainage, utilities and sewers
claims.proposition: Ground/geotechnics, drainage, utilities and sewer conditions are unknown at admitted evidence.
claims.limitation: Historical planning permission does not discharge technical/site due diligence.

claims.subject: title and private rights
claims.proposition: Title, easements, covenants, rights and related private constraints are unknown.
claims.limitation: No title/private-right conclusion is inferred from public planning history.

candidateAuthoring.reason: The admitted corpus evidence does not establish legal/survey parcel geometry, frontage/depth, reliable levels or exact access relationship sufficient to author a controlled Reference House placement without guessing.
missingEvidence: authoritative legal or survey parcel boundary geometry
authoritative frontage/depth/shape sufficient to test 12.0m x 10.8m Reference House footprint
reliable site coordinate/orientation frame tied to the real parcel
surveyed site levels/topography sufficient to author a ground-floor datum
surveyed physical access geometry and street/approach relationship
title/control relationship sufficient to know the land on which placement is being authored

syntheticVocabularyBoundary.reason: DPL-13B reference-site coverage binds synthetic RS-* claim ids carrying fixture-specific parcel/frame/placement propositions. RP-003 retains its real corpus claim ids; owner-family mapping is explicit rather than achieved by synthetic renaming.
